notes:
- Proximity voice chat in co-op: press T to turn your mic on or off. Teammates hear you from where
  you are, getting quieter with distance (out to about 40 m), and a speaker icon shows over whoever is
  talking. A mic icon next to your health bar shows when your mic is on and turns green while you're being heard.
  Only speech is sent (it stops when you go quiet), compressed with Opus, with RNNoise noise suppression.
- Text chat: press Enter to type, Enter to send, Esc to close. Messages show bottom left with the
  sender's name in their colour and fade after a few seconds. The lobby has a chat box too, and lobby
  messages carry over into the game. You also see a message when someone leaves.
- Settings are split into GAME / VIDEO / VOICE tabs. VOICE has: Voice Chat on/off, Voice Volume,
  Mute Everyone, Microphone (when you have more than one), Mic Volume, Noise Suppression and a Mic Test
  (hear yourself back and watch the level meter; it turns green when you'd be heard).
- The browser (web) build is discontinued, so the game can use desktop-only features like voice chat.
